conformity.B1_one_record_per_subject: each subject carries exactly ONE expectation record (Bayesian shape); positions cite the subject record; no per-position re-estimates, no parallel numbers on views/ledger lines

conformity.B4_private_ledger_first: B4 as ruled (owner ruling via main 2026-11-02, discharged by DoE): PRIVATE LEDGER FIRST stands — ledger of record unchanged, entries internal, stakes observational, no external participation — AND a public READ-ONLY render of the ledger records on our own dashboard is authorized (book-feed.json). The original no-listing condition is SUPERSEDED by this ruling; the PASS stands.
conformity.B5_rules9_significance: Rule 9 + significance standard bind any stated probability/standing from the book (single-leg = HELD, sub-bar = no established language); the hidden metrics_internal winprob stays in its own home — the book cites records, it does not republish that metric values; stakes observational units per lane scope guard
